Question:
What is true of the opposite sides of a rectangle?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p077_q1_question_en.svg)

Choices.A: Opposite sides are equal in length
Choices.B: All four sides have different lengths

Solution: Each pair of opposite sides of a rectangle is equal in length, and all four angles are right angles.
